name: Vegetable Biryani
instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
Sauté sliced onion and vegetables with spices.
Add rice and water, then cook until fluffy.
Rest for 10 minutes and serve.
description: Fragrant rice with vegetables and warming spices.

name: Masala Dosa
instructions: Cook mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and mashed potato together.
Spread dosa batter thinly on a hot pan.
Add potato filling, fold and serve.
description: Crisp dosa filled with spiced potato.

name: Chana Masala
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger.
Add tomato and spices and cook until thick.
Stir in chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
description: A comforting chickpea curry.

name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 240°C.
Spread tomato over rolled dough.
Add mozzarella and basil.
Bake until the crust is golden.
description: Classic tomato, mozzarella and basil pizza.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente.
Gently warm sliced garlic and chili in olive oil.
Toss pasta with a little pasta water and parsley.
description: Quick garlic and olive oil pasta.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Heat a little oil in a wok.
Stir-fry garlic and chopped vegetables.
Add rice and soy sauce and toss over high heat.
Finish with spring onion.
description: A fast way to use leftover rice and vegetables.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble the eggs in a hot pan and set aside.
Stir-fry peas and rice.
Add soy sauce, egg and spring onion; toss well.
description: Simple fried rice with egg.

name: Miso Soup
instructions: Warm water or dashi without boiling hard.
Whisk miso paste with a little warm broth.
Add tofu and seaweed, then stir in miso.
Top with spring onion.
description: A light Japanese soup.

name: Vegetable Ramen
instructions: Cook noodles according to the packet.
Simmer garlic, mushrooms and soy sauce in broth.
Add spinach and noodles.
Serve with spring onion.
description: Warm noodle soup with vegetables.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
instructions: Chop kimchi and sauté it briefly.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce.
Stir-fry until hot and finish with sesame oil.
description: Tangy, savory Korean fried rice.

name: Vegetable Tacos
instructions: Warm the black beans and corn with seasoning.
Fill tortillas with the mixture.
Top with tomato, avocado and lime juice.
description: Fresh tacos with beans, corn and avocado.

name: Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocado with lime juice.
Fold in chopped tomato, onion and cilantro.
Season and serve immediately.
description: Creamy avocado dip.

name: Pad Thai-Style Noodles
instructions: Soak or cook rice noodles as directed.
Scramble egg in a hot pan.
Add noodles and sauce, then toss with sprouts.
Serve with crushed peanuts and lime.
description: A quick home-style noodle dish inspired by pad thai.

name: Thai Coconut Vegetable Curry
instructions: Cook curry paste briefly in a saucepan.
Add coconut milk and chopped vegetables.
Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Serve with rice.
description: Creamy coconut curry with vegetables.

name: Falafel
instructions: Pulse soaked chickpeas with herbs, onion and spices.
Shape into small patties and chill briefly.
Pan-fry or bake until crisp and cooked through.
description: Herby chickpea patties.

name: Hummus
instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic.
Add water gradually until smooth.
Finish with olive oil.
description: Smooth chickpea and tahini dip.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: Cook onion and pepper until soft.
Add tomatoes and paprika and simmer until thick.
Make wells and add eggs.
Cover until eggs reach your preferred doneness.
description: Eggs gently cooked in spiced tomato sauce.

name: French Ratatouille
instructions: Slice vegetables evenly.
Sauté onion and garlic, then add tomato.
Layer or stir in remaining vegetables.
Cover and cook until tender.
description: Rustic Provençal vegetable stew.

name: Crêpes
instructions: Whisk flour, milk and egg into a smooth batter.
Rest for 10 minutes if possible.
Cook thin layers in a lightly buttered pan, flipping once.
description: Thin French pancakes for sweet or savory fillings.

name: Spanish Patatas Bravas
instructions: Cube potatoes and roast or pan-fry until crisp.
Cook tomato, garlic and paprika into a sauce.
Serve potatoes with the sauce.
description: Crispy potatoes with a smoky tomato sauce.

name: Vegetable Paella
instructions: Sauté pepper and tomato in a wide pan.
Stir in rice and saffron.
Add hot stock and peas; simmer without stirring much until rice is tender.
description: Spanish-style rice with vegetables and saffron.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop tomato, cucumber and onion.
Add olives and feta.
Dress with olive oil and oregano.
description: Fresh salad with feta and olives.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in one bowl.
Whisk milk and egg, then combine gently.
Cook small portions on a lightly greased pan until bubbles form; flip.
description: Fluffy breakfast pancakes.

name: Black Bean Quesadillas
instructions: Mash beans lightly and mix with corn and pepper.
Spread filling and cheese on half a tortilla.
Fold and toast on both sides until crisp.
description: Crispy tortillas filled with beans and cheese.

name: Bibimbap-Inspired Bowl
instructions: Cook rice and prepare vegetables separately.
Sauté mushrooms and wilt spinach.
Arrange vegetables over rice and add a cooked egg.
Serve with a suitable sauce if available.
description: A colorful Korean-inspired rice bowl.

name: Bunny Chow-Inspired Curry Bread
instructions: Sauté onion with curry powder.
Add tomato and chickpeas and simmer until thick.
Hollow out bread portions and fill with curry.
description: A plant-based take inspired by a South African street-food favorite.

name: Jollof Rice
instructions: Blend tomato, pepper and onion.
Cook the blended mixture with spices until reduced.
Add washed rice and stock, cover and cook until tender.
description: A beloved West African tomato rice dish.

name: Injera-Style Lentil Stew
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add tomato, spice and rinsed lentils.
Add water and simmer until soft, stirring as needed.
description: A simple lentil stew inspired by Ethiopian misir wot.

name: Pierogi-Inspired Potato Dumplings
instructions: Make a simple dough with flour and water.
Prepare mashed potato with onion and cheese.
Fill and seal small dough rounds.
Boil until they float, then optionally pan-fry.
description: Homestyle potato-filled dumplings inspired by pierogi.

name: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar.
Place rice on nori and add vegetable strips.
Roll tightly and slice with a sharp damp knife.
description: Fresh vegetable sushi rolls.

name: Pesto Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta and reserve some pasta water.
Blend basil, garlic, nuts, cheese and olive oil.
Toss pasta with pesto and a splash of pasta water.
description: Pasta coated in fragrant basil pesto.

name: Couscous Vegetable Bowl
instructions: Pour hot stock over couscous and cover.
Cook chopped vegetables with cumin until tender.
Fold in chickpeas and raisins; serve over couscous.
description: A North African-inspired couscous bowl.

name: Pav Bhaji
instructions: Boil and mash vegetables.
Cook onion and tomato with pav bhaji masala.
Mix in vegetables and simmer until rich.
Serve with toasted bread rolls.
description: Mumbai-style spiced mashed vegetables with bread.

name: Vegetable Momos
instructions: Make a firm dough and rest it.
Mix finely chopped vegetables with garlic and soy sauce.
Fill dough rounds and seal.
Steam until the wrappers are cooked.
description: Steamed vegetable dumplings.

name: Adobo-Inspired Tofu
instructions: Press and cube tofu, then brown it in a pan.
Add garlic, soy sauce, vinegar and bay leaf.
Simmer until the sauce reduces; serve with rice.
description: A plant-based dish inspired by Filipino adobo flavors.

name: Poutine-Inspired Potato Bowl
instructions: Cut potatoes into fries and bake or fry until crisp.
Warm the gravy.
Top fries with cheese curds and hot gravy.
description: A home-style take on a Canadian comfort food.

name: Vegemite Toast
instructions: Toast bread until golden.
Spread with butter.
Add a very thin layer of Vegemite and serve.
description: A simple Australian breakfast snack.

name: Brazilian Black Bean Stew
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add cooked black beans, tomato and cumin.
Simmer until flavors combine and serve with rice.
description: A comforting black bean stew inspired by Brazilian flavors.

name: Peruvian Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lime and a pinch of salt.
Spread on toast and top with tomato and cilantro.
description: Fresh avocado toast with bright lime.

name: Swiss Cheese Rösti
instructions: Grate potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture.
Mix with seasoning and optional grated cheese.
Press into a hot buttered pan and cook until crisp on both sides.
description: Crispy Swiss-style grated potato cake.

name: Turkish Menemen
instructions: Sauté onion and pepper until soft.
Add chopped tomato and cook until saucy.
Add beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
description: Soft scrambled eggs with tomatoes and peppers.

name: Swedish Potato Hash
instructions: Dice cooked potatoes and onion.
Pan-fry in butter until browned.
Serve with a fried egg and parsley.
description: A simple Scandinavian-style potato hash.

name: Vietnamese Fresh Spring Rolls
instructions: Prepare noodles and cut vegetables into thin strips.
Soften rice paper in water briefly.
Add noodles, vegetables and mint, then roll tightly.
description: Fresh rice-paper rolls with crisp vegetables.

name: Indonesian Peanut Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles and rinse briefly if desired.
Mix peanut butter with soy sauce, lime, garlic and warm water.
Toss noodles with sauce and top with cucumber.
description: Noodles with a quick peanut-lime sauce.

name: Malaysian Coconut Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook rice with coconut milk and water.
Slice cucumber and prepare peanuts.
Serve rice with cucumber, peanuts and chili to taste.
description: A simplified coconut rice bowl inspired by nasi lemak.

name: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender and slice.
Warm onion with stock, vinegar and mustard.
Toss with potatoes and parsley; serve warm.
description: Tangy potato salad with mustard dressing.

name: British Jacket Potato
instructions: Prick potato and bake at 200°C until tender.
Split and fluff the inside with butter.
Top with beans and cheese.
description: A baked potato with a hearty topping.

name: Argentinian Chimichurri Bean Bowl
instructions: Mix parsley, garlic, olive oil and vinegar for chimichurri.
Warm beans with seasoning.
Serve over rice with the herb sauce.
description: A plant-based bowl with a bright herb sauce.

name: Sri Lankan Coconut Lentils
instructions: Rinse lentils and simmer with water and turmeric.
Add coconut milk and cook until soft.
Sauté onion and curry leaves and stir through.
description: Creamy coconut lentils inspired by parippu.

name: Pakistani Chana Pulao
instructions: Sauté onion and spices.
Add chickpeas and washed rice.
Add water and cook covered until rice is tender.
description: Spiced rice cooked with chickpeas.

name: Bangladeshi Khichuri-Inspired Rice
instructions: Rinse rice and lentils.
Sauté onion and ginger with turmeric.
Add rice, lentils and water; simmer until soft.
description: Comforting rice and lentils inspired by khichuri.

name: Afghan Carrot Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook rice until nearly tender.
Sauté shredded carrot with cumin and onion.
Fold through rice with raisins and steam until done.
description: A simple sweet-savory rice dish inspired by Afghan flavors.

name: Iranian Herb Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook rice until fluffy.
Chop herbs and fold through rice or serve alongside.
Add yogurt as a cool accompaniment.
description: Herb-forward rice inspired by Persian sabzi polo.

name: Russian Olivier-Inspired Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes, carrots and eggs, then cool and dice.
Mix with peas and yogurt dressing.
Chill before serving.
description: A lighter home-style salad inspired by Olivier salad.

name: Ukrainian Beet Soup-Inspired Bowl
instructions: Sauté onion and carrot.
Add diced beetroot, potato, cabbage, tomato and stock.
Simmer until all vegetables are tender.
description: A vegetable soup inspired by borscht.

name: Dutch Potato and Vegetable Mash
instructions: Boil potatoes and kale until tender.
Drain and mash with milk and butter.
Season and serve warm.
description: A simple mash inspired by Dutch stamppot.

name: Belgian Leek Soup
instructions: Sauté leek and onion.
Add potato and stock; simmer until soft.
Blend until smooth and stir in cream.
description: Creamy leek and potato soup.

name: Austrian Apple Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, milk and egg into batter.
Fold in thin apple slices and cinnamon.
Cook small pancakes until golden on both sides.
description: Apple pancakes inspired by Central European home cooking.

name: Hungarian Paprika Potato Stew
instructions: Sauté onion and bell pepper.
Add paprika, tomato and diced potato.
Add water and simmer until potatoes are tender.
description: A warming paprika-seasoned potato stew.

name: Romanian Polenta Bowl
instructions: Bring salted water to a simmer.
Whisk in cornmeal gradually and cook until thick.
Serve with cheese and yogurt if desired.
description: A simple polenta dish inspired by mămăligă.

name: Georgian Bean Stew
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add cooked beans and spices with a splash of water.
Simmer, then finish with chopped cilantro.
description: A bean stew inspired by Georgian lobio.

name: Armenian Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and carrot.
Add lentils, tomato, cumin and stock.
Simmer until lentils are tender.
description: A hearty lentil soup.

name: Israeli Shakshuka Bowl
instructions: Cook onion and pepper until softened.
Add tomato and paprika and simmer.
Add eggs and cover until set.
description: Eggs in a rich tomato-pepper sauce.

name: Saudi Arabian Spiced Rice
instructions: Sauté onion with cumin and a pinch of cinnamon.
Add tomato, carrot, rice and stock.
Cover and cook until rice is tender.
description: A simple aromatic rice dish inspired by kabsa flavors.

name: Kenyan Githeri
instructions: Sauté onion and tomato.
Add cooked beans, corn and diced potato.
Add a little water and simmer until tender.
description: A hearty beans-and-maize dish.

name: Ghanaian Red Red-Inspired Beans
instructions: Cook black-eyed peas until tender.
Sauté onion, garlic and tomato with paprika.
Stir beans into the sauce and simmer.
description: A tomato-rich bean stew inspired by Ghanaian red red.

name: Ecuadorian Corn and Bean Bowl
instructions: Warm beans and corn with seasoning.
Chop tomato and avocado.
Combine and finish with lime juice.
description: A fresh, quick Andean-inspired bowl.

name: Chilean Tomato Bread
instructions: Toast or warm the bread.
Rub lightly with garlic if desired.
Top with grated tomato, olive oil and salt.
description: A simple tomato-topped bread inspired by pan con tomate traditions across the region.

name: Uruguayan Cheese Toast
instructions: Top bread with tomato and cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano.
Toast until the cheese melts.
description: A quick toasted cheese snack.

name: New Zealand Kumara Roast
instructions: Cut sweet potato into wedges.
Toss with oil, rosemary and seasoning.
Roast at 200°C until tender and browned.
description: Roasted kumara-inspired sweet potato wedges.

name: Fijian Coconut Vegetable Curry
instructions: Sauté onion with curry powder.
Add diced vegetables and coconut milk.
Simmer until vegetables are soft.
description: A simple island-style coconut curry.

name: Samoan Coconut Vegetable Bowl
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add spinach and coconut milk and simmer gently.
Serve with rice.
description: A greens-and-coconut dish inspired by island cooking.

name: Mongolian Noodle Stir-Fry
instructions: Cook noodles according to packet instructions.
Stir-fry onion, carrot and cabbage.
Add noodles and soy sauce and toss until hot.
description: A quick noodle stir-fry inspired by Mongolian home-style flavors.

name: Uzbek Carrot Rice
instructions: Sauté onion and carrot until softened.
Add cumin, rice and water or stock.
Add garlic and cook covered until rice is tender.
description: A simplified carrot rice inspired by plov.

name: Kazakh Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate potato and onion and squeeze out excess liquid.
Mix with egg and flour.
Pan-fry small pancakes until cooked and golden.
description: Crispy potato pancakes.

name: Cambodian Vegetable Amok-Inspired Curry
instructions: Warm coconut milk with finely chopped lemongrass.
Add pumpkin and simmer until tender.
Stir in spinach and serve with rice.
description: A vegetable curry inspired by Cambodian amok flavors.

name: Laotian Herb Rice Salad
instructions: Cool cooked rice slightly.
Toss with chopped herbs, cucumber and lime.
Top with peanuts and serve.
description: A bright herb-and-rice bowl.

name: Myanmar Tea Leaf-Inspired Salad
instructions: Shred cabbage and chop tomato.
Mix lime, garlic and sesame oil for dressing.
Toss vegetables with peanuts and dressing.
description: A crunchy salad inspired by Burmese tea leaf salad textures.

name: Bhutanese Red Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook red rice until tender.
Sauté mushrooms and garlic.
Add spinach and a little soy sauce, then serve over rice.
description: A simple rice bowl inspired by Himalayan ingredients.

name: Maldivian Coconut Tuna-Inspired Rice
instructions: Cook rice and set aside.
Sauté onion and mix with tuna and coconut.
Serve over rice with lime.
description: A quick tuna-and-coconut rice bowl inspired by Maldivian flavors.
